detail.title: Electric clamping jaw based on bidirectional polarization type high-thrust electromagnet
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses an electronic clamping jaw based on two-way polarization formula high thrust electro-magnet, including shell, electromagnetic drive mechanism, push rod, clamping jaw, electromagnetic drive mechanism installs the inboard both sides at the shell, electromagnetic drive mechanism is including installation shell, coil carrier, front end permanent magnet, coil, soft magnet, armature, rear end permanent magnet, electro-magnet rear end cap, the inside both sides at the shell are installed to the installation shell, the inboard at the installation shell is installed to the coil carrier, the inboard at the coil carrier is installed to the coil, the lower extreme one side at the coil carrier is installed to the front end permanent magnet, one side that the front end permanent magnet was kept away from to the lower extreme at the coil carrier is installed to the rear end permanent magnet, soft magnet is installed between front end permanent magnet, rear end permanent magnet. The utility model discloses simple structure, low cost, clamping-force are stable and adjustable, can realize that sensorless's empty claw detects, keep certain clamping-force, safe and reliable after the outage.
assignees: 武创智达科技（杭州）有限公司
